webOnly.reason: Archiving is a Home affordance over the Inbox list; the CLI has no list to archive from
Deliberately no command: an agent drives the draft flow (draft create → submit) so inline comments ride a reviewed submit; direct inline posting is the web's affordance
Erasing the viewer's own pasted row is a Home affordance behind a confirm; the CLI has no list to delete from
Deleting a pull request's briefs is a Home affordance behind a confirm; the CLI has no list to delete from
A per-user banner preference; the CLI has no banner
Token management is cookie-only: /api/auth/* ignores Bearer headers, so a token can never list tokens
Minting a credential is a browser act — /api/auth/* ignores Bearer headers so a stolen token cannot mint another
Deleting a repository's attachment branch is a Home affordance behind a typed confirm, and the route is cookie-only; a token cannot sign the reviewer's confirmation
An image the browser loads inline from a comment body; the CLI prints the body's markdown with the GitHub URL in it
The hunk-edge expander is a diff-viewer affordance; the CLI has no rendered diff to expand around
The live stack feeds the header's neighbour links; the CLI renders no brief header to navigate from
Signing out everywhere is cookie-only like minting: /api/auth/* ignores Bearer headers so a stolen token cannot sign its owner out
Revocation is cookie-only for the same reason as minting: a stolen token must not be able to revoke the owner's tokens
Unarchiving is a Home affordance over the archived view; the CLI has no list to restore to
